wheelchair_availability: Wheelchairs and wheelchair-accessible pathways are available near the main darshan entry barricades and car parking areas.
priority_darshan: Elders with walking difficulties are directed through specialized, significantly shorter queue channels (often utilizing special entry paths/Seegra Darshan lines) to bypass lengthy winding queue halls.
transit_and_ghat_road: Personal cars and private cabs are permitted to drive directly up the south-side Ghat Road all the way to the hilltop complex parking lots. For pilgrims without personal vehicles, the temple board operates a continuous fleet of free Devasthanam shuttle buses to eliminate strenuous hill climbs; local auto-rickshaws are restricted from the main climb.
ramps_and_lifts: Dedicated temple elevator operates directly at the West Gopuram side, transporting elderly and physically challenged pilgrims straight to the 1st-floor main upper sanctum level for a comfortable eye-level darshan without climbing stairs.
guidelines: Seniors can request the lift operator at the West Gopuram entrance for direct sanctum access. Fully air-conditioned, well-ventilated Vratham halls with comfortable floor seating arrangements are available for participating in the multi-hour Satyanarayana Vratham pooja.
